verdict.rationale: skills.sh documents a one-command install path (`npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`) and says skills install "with a single command". A runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npm with no account and can list a repo's skills without installing, so getting from nothing to an installed skill looks fast. However, there is no dedicated quickstart guide and no timed or hands-on record of an actual install that was then verified working in an agent, so the under-five-minutes claim is only implied. missing for 10: a dedicated step-by-step quickstart page, a hands-on probe of a real `skills add` install verified working in an agent, independent timing corroboration of under five minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes

citations.quote: Install them with a single command to enhance your agents with access to procedural knowledge.
the skills CLI ran keylessly from npm — `npx -y skills --version` printed 1.5.24 with no account
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y
